title: Game developer House House confirms using AI during Big Walk's final development, sparking an intense debate among Independent Games Festival judges and jurors (Luke Plunkett/Aftermath)
summary: Luke Plunkett / Aftermath: Game developer House House confirms using AI during Big Walk's final development, sparking an intense debate among Independent Games Festival judges and jurors — 'We support the work of those who are trying to limit the harm generative AI is doing to videogames and our world …
